current_state.existing_categories: Cat42=Shot Quality, Cat45=Player Tracking (6211 raw features, 43 categories)

cat47_shot_zone_efficiency.category: Cat47 — Shot Chart Spatial Zone Efficiency Matrix
metrics_per_zone: team_efg_vs_def (team efg in zone vs opponent def efg allowed)
opp_zone_weakness (opponent allowed efg - league avg per zone)

cat48_player_impact.rationale: PIE/BPM respond faster to roster changes than team stats — especially valuable at season start and after trades
cat48_player_impact.data_source: NBA Stats API /leaguedashplayerstats — PIE column directly available

calibration_addendum.finding: CalibratedClassifierCV with auto-selection (isotonic vs sigmoid) achieves Brier ~0.20 on NBA 2024 test
calibration_addendum.action: fit both methods, keep whichever gives lower validation Brier
calibration_addendum.code: cal_iso = CalibratedClassifierCV(base, method='isotonic', cv=3); cal_sig = CalibratedClassifierCV(base, method='sigmoid', cv=3); keep = min([cal_iso, cal_sig], key=lambda c: brier_score_loss(y_val, c.predict_proba(X_val)[:,1]))

expected_impact.note: S15 wide-search already at 200 features and hit 0.2201 — suggests wider spatial feature base helps extra_trees specifically
